description: Search EV charging stations by city, state, network, connector, speed, power or live availability. Returns station details including name, address, connector types and pricing, sorted by station name.

available_now.description: Only stations showing a free port in a live reading under 15 minutes old. Live availability is available only to clients with a commercial API key; without one, this filter is ignored and the answer lists it under ignored_filters.

connector.description: Connector type, case-insensitive: CCS, NACS, CHAdeMO, J1772, or a raw NREL code (J1772COMBO, TESLA, CHADEMO). Comma-separate to match any.

min_power_kw.description: Minimum charger power in kW (e.g. 50, 150, 250). 150 and up only match stations with a known wattage.

speed.description: Charging level: dcfc (DC fast), level2 or level1

state.description: State: two-letter abbreviation (CO), name (Colorado) or slug (colorado)

name: search_stations
title: Search charging stations
